title: Web Hosting Plans Benefit Card: Hosting Credit on Grace-Period Renewals of Domain Registrations
content:
## Benefit card — hosting credit on a lapsed-year renewal

**Rule.** For a grace-period renewal of Domain Registrations billed on or after 1 December 2025, the lapsed-year hosting credit, one of the lapsed-year credits of that renewal, is USD 3.00 for each renewed year where a Harborline hosting plan under Web Hosting Plans whose primary domain is this domain has status active and a billing term of 12 months or more, USD 1.50 for each renewed year where such a plan has status active and a billing term of 1 month, and nothing otherwise.

### Decision table

| Hosting plan whose primary domain is the renewed domain | Billing term of that plan | Lapsed-year hosting credit |
|---|---|---|
| Status active | 12 months or more | USD 3.00 for each renewed year |
| Status active | 1 month | USD 1.50 for each renewed year |
| Status active | any other term | nothing |
| No plan in status active (none held, or held in another status) | — | nothing |
| An active plan whose primary domain is a different domain | — | nothing |

### Reading the records

- The plan is identified by its primary domain on the Web Hosting Plans record: it must be the very domain being renewed, not another domain on the same account.
- The billing term is the term recorded on that plan; a term of exactly 12 months already earns the annual figure, and a term of exactly 1 month earns the monthly figure.
- The plan's status must read active; any other status earns nothing.

### Hypothetical cases

- A domain is the primary domain of an active plan on a 24-month term: USD 3.00 for the renewed year.
- A domain is the primary domain of an active plan on a 1-month term: USD 1.50 for the renewed year.
- The only plan on the account is active but set up for a different primary domain: nothing.
